versos.grego: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε.

controles.web: “These things have I spoken to you, so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
controles.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
controles.livre: Estas coisas tenho vos dito para que não vos ofendeis.

versos.grego: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς· ἀλλ’ ἔρχεται ὥρα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξῃ λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
controles.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
controles.livre: Expulsarão a vós das sinagogas; mas a hora vem, quando qualquer que vos matar, pensará fazer serviço a Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ταῦτα ποιήσουσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν Πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ.

controles.web: They will do these thingsbecause they have not known the Father, nor me.
controles.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
controles.livre: E estas coisas vos farão, porque nem ao Pai, nem a mim me conheceram.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἡ ὥρα αὐτῶν μνημονεύητε αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν. ταῦτα δὲ ὑμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς οὐκ εἶπον, ὅτι μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἤμην.

controles.web: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
controles.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
controles.livre: Porém tenho vos dito isto para que, quando aquela hora vier, disso vos lembreis, que já o dissera a vós; mas isto eu não vos disse desde o princípio, porque eu estava convosco.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με Ποῦ ὑπάγεις;

controles.web: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
controles.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
controles.livre: E agora vou para aquele que me enviou; e nenhum de vós me pergunta: Para onde vais?

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν, ἡ λύπη πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν.

controles.web: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
controles.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
controles.livre: Porém, porque vos disse estas coisas, a tristeza encheu vosso coração.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν, συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω. ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ ἀπέλθω, ὁ Παράκλητος οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐὰν δὲ πορευθῶ, πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
controles.livre: Mas vos digo a verdade, que vos convém que eu vá; porque se eu não for, o Consolador não virá a vós; porém se eu for, eu o enviarei a vós.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως·

controles.web: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
controles.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
controles.livre: E vindo ele, convencerá ao mundo do pecado, e da justiça, e do juízo.

versos.grego: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν, ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ·

controles.web: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
controles.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
controles.livre: Do pecado, porque não creem em mim;

versos.grego: περὶ δικαιοσύνης δέ, ὅτι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ὑπάγω καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με·

controles.web: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
controles.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
controles.livre: E da justiça, porque vou para meu Pai, e não me vereis mais;

versos.grego: περὶ δὲ κρίσεως, ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κέκριται.

controles.web: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
controles.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
controles.livre: E do juízo, porque o Príncipe deste mundo já está julgado.

versos.grego: Ἔτι πολλὰ ἔχω ὑμῖν λέγειν, ἀλλ’ οὐ δύνασθε βαστάζειν ἄρτι·

controles.web: “I have yet many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
controles.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
controles.livre: Ainda tenho muitas coisas que vos dizer, mas agora ainda não podeis suportá-las.

versos.grego: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἀλήθειαν πᾶσαν· οὐ γὰρ λαλήσει ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ, ἀλλ’ ὅσα ἀκούει λαλήσει, καὶ τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

controles.web: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
controles.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
controles.livre: Porém quando vier aquele Espírito de verdade, ele vos guiará em toda verdade. Porque de si mesmo não falará; mas falará tudo o que ouvir; E ele vos anunciará as coisas que virão.

versos.grego: ἐκεῖνος ἐμὲ δοξάσει, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λήμψεται καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

controles.web: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
controles.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
controles.livre: Ele me glorificará, porque tomará do que é meu, e vos anunciará.

versos.grego: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ Πατὴρ ἐμά ἐστιν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαμβάνει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.

controles.web: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takesof mine, and will declare it to you.
controles.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
controles.livre: Tudo quanto tem o Pai é meu; por isso eu disse, que tomará do que é meu, e vos anunciará.

versos.grego: Μικρὸν καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με.

controles.web: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
controles.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
controles.livre: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e mais um pouco, e me vereis.

versos.grego: Εἶπαν οὖν ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀλλήλους Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με; καί Ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα;

controles.web: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
controles.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
controles.livre: Disseram pois alguns de seus discípulos uns aos outros: Que é isto que ele nos diz: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e mais um pouco, e me vereis; e porque vou ao Pai?

versos.grego: ἔλεγον οὖν Τοῦτο τί ἐστιν ὃ λέγει τὸ μικρόν; οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λαλεῖ.

controles.web: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
controles.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
controles.livre: Então diziam: Que é isto que ele diz? Um pouco? Não sabemos o que diz.

versos.grego: ἔγνω Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤθελον αὐτὸν ἐρωτᾶν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Περὶ τούτου ζητεῖτε μετ’ ἀλλήλων ὅτι εἶπον Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με;

controles.web: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’
controles.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
controles.livre: Conheceu pois Jesus que lhe queriam perguntar, e disse-lhes: Perguntais entre vós sobre isto que disse: Um pouco, e não me vereis; e mais um pouco, e me vereis?

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται· ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλ’ ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que vós chorareis, e lamentareis, e o mundo se alegrará, e vós estareis tristes; mas vossa tristeza se tornará em alegria.

versos.grego: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς· ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

controles.web: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
controles.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
controles.livre: A mulher quando está no parto tem tristeza, porque sua hora é vinda; mas havendo nascido a criança, já não se lembra da aflição, pela alegria de um homem ter nascido no mundo.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν νῦν μὲν λύπην ἔχετε· πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς αἴρει ἀφ’ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
controles.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
controles.livre: Assim também vós agora na verdade tendes tristeza; mas novamente vos verei, e vosso coração se alegrará, e ninguém tirará vossa alegria de vós.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν. ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἄν τι αἰτήσητε τὸν Πατέρα δώσει ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου.

controles.web: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
controles.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
controles.livre: E naquele dia nada me perguntareis. Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que tudo quanto pedirdes a meu Pai em meu nome, ele vos dará.

versos.grego: ἕως ἄρτι οὐκ ᾐτήσατε οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου· αἰτεῖτε, καὶ λήμψεσθε, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.

controles.web: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
controles.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
controles.livre: Até agora nada pedistes em meu nome; pedi, e recebereis, para que vossa alegria seja completa.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα ἐν παροιμίαις λελάληκα ὑμῖν· ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὐκέτι ἐν παροιμίαις λαλήσω ὑμῖν, ἀλλὰ παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ Πατρὸς ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν.

controles.web: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
controles.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
controles.livre: Estas coisas vos falei por parábolas; porém a hora vem quando não mais vos falarei por parábolas; mas vos falarei abertamente sobre o Pai.

versos.grego: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτήσεσθε, καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν Πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν·

controles.web: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,
controles.kjv: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
controles.livre: Naquele dia pedireis em meu nome; e não vos digo, que eu suplicarei ao Pai por vós.

versos.grego: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐμὲ πεφιλήκατε καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον.

controles.web: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
controles.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
controles.livre: Pois o próprio Pai vos ama, porque vós me amastes, e crestes que eu saí de Deus.

versos.grego: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον· πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα.

controles.web: I came from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.”
controles.kjv: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
controles.livre: Saí do Pai, e vim ao mundo; novamente deixo o mundo, e vou ao Pai.

versos.grego: Λέγουσιν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ Ἴδε νῦν ἐν παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖς, καὶ παροιμίαν οὐδεμίαν λέγεις.

controles.web: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.
controles.kjv: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe seus Discípulos: Eis que agora falas abertamente, e nenhuma parábola dizes.

versos.grego: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις ἵνα τίς σε ἐρωτᾷ· ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθες.

controles.web: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
controles.kjv: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
controles.livre: Agora sabemos que sabes todas as coisas; e não necessitas que ninguém te pergunte. Por isso cremos que saíste de Deus.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς Ἄρτι πιστεύετε;

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
controles.kjv: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Agora credes?

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια κἀμὲ μόνον ἀφῆτε· καὶ οὐκ εἰμὶ μόνος, ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν.

controles.web: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
controles.kjv: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
controles.livre: Eis que a hora vem, e já é chegada, quando sereis dispersos, cada um por si, e me deixareis só. Porém não estou só, porque o Pai está comigo.

versos.grego: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ εἰρήνην ἔχητε. ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ θλῖψιν ἔχετε· ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε, ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον.

controles.web: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
controles.kjv: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
controles.livre: Estas coisas tenho vos dito para que tenhais paz em mim; no mundo tereis aflição; mas tende bom ânimo; eu venci o mundo.
